name: planes-con-alma
description: PWA para organizar planes, preparada para Cloudflare Workers Static Assets

scripts.check: node --check public/app.js && node --check public/sw.js && node --check worker/index.js && node --check scripts/configure-d1.mjs
scripts.deploy:d1: npm run configure:d1 && npx wrangler d1 execute planes-con-alma --remote --file=schema.sql && npx wrangler deploy
